meta.name: Hot Wheels Action: Thomas & Friends
meta.description:
Rev up your imagination and hit the fast lane with Hot Wheels Action! Buckle up for thrilling races through the world of Hot Wheels, epic battles with He-man, and railway adventures with Thomas & Friends! Endless fun for kids of all ages!

Shows: Thomas & Friends, Monster Trucks, He-Man and The Masters of the Universe, Hot Wheels Ultimate Garage, Matchbox Adventures
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
